title: Align worker sandbox mounts with atomic canonical state publication

owned: Worker sandbox filesystem mount alignment: moving state.json and approval-queue.json into dedicated mutable directory (.orchestrator/worker-runtime/) mounted via --bind while retaining read-only enclosing .orchestrator/ mount via --ro-bind.

Task-store publication race resolution: moving V2 TaskStore files (task-state-events-v2.jsonl, head.json, lock, legacy-anchor.json) into dedicated directory (task-state/) mounted via --bind, eliminating transient head tmp scan failures.
Strict authority precondition in common.write_status under exclusive snapshot_transaction lock (event_count > 0) preventing stale host writers from recreating retired/uninitialized journals.
Supervisor control files (PID, lock, watchdog state, rotation cooldowns) anchored strictly to canonical status_root/.orchestrator coordination root.
Runtime promotion single-writer storage migration and transactional rollback in promote_supervisor_runtime.py.
Permission broker canonical status path binding with fallback defaults in permission_broker.py.
not_changing: No bypass of bubblewrap isolation or sandbox boundaries.
No alteration to V2 TaskStore commit schema or journal hashes.
No removal of canonical review gates or reviewer policies.
composes_with: V2 TaskStore canonical journal and event log

failure_reproduction.case_1_erofs_atomic_state_write: Worker atomic file replacement in sandbox failed with EROFS because state.json was an inode bind mount inside a read-only directory.
failure_reproduction.case_2_transient_head_publication_enoent: bwrap failed on worker launch with ENOENT when scanning transient publication temp files in task store parent directory.
failure_reproduction.case_3_stale_journal_recreation: common.write_status without existing-authority check recreated empty/retired journals when invoked with legacy configs.
failure_reproduction.case_4_control_file_drift: Moving state_file risked drifting supervisor control files into worker-writable directories if derived from state_file parent.

implementation.worker_runner: Replaced individual file mounts for state.json and approval-queue.json with a directory bind mount for .orchestrator/worker-runtime/. Replaced task store sibling scan with a directory bind mount for task-state/.
implementation.common: Added canonical_status_paths with fill_defaults; added existing-authority precondition in write_status under snapshot_transaction.
implementation.supervisor: Anchored supervisor.pid, supervisor.lock, watchdog state, and rotation cooldowns to status_root / .orchestrator.
implementation.promote_supervisor_runtime: Added _migrate_storage_paths and transactional rollback during supervisor promotion.
implementation.permission_broker: Updated runtime config loading to bind paths using canonical_status_paths.
implementation.provision_live_supervisor_config: Set default task_state_store paths under task-state/ directory.

review_remediation.defect_1_mount_builder_layout_qualificat: Enforced parent.name == 'task-state' in _append_task_store_mounts, rejecting legacy or mixed directory layouts. Verified parent directory contains only allowed TaskStore files and transient publication temp files. Applied directory-level read-only protection (--ro-bind-try) on outer_runtime preventing atomic replacement or linking over sibling files (e.g. live-supervisor.json) while preserving --bind writeability on nested leased worktrees.
review_remediation.defect_2_single_writer_cutover_and_watch: Acquired runtime-admission.lock via fcntl.flock in _replace_supervisor_locked covering shutdown, migration, queue marker, config write, and supervisor launch. Added lock drain in _migrate_storage_paths acquiring nonblocking exclusive flock on events.jsonl.lock before cutover, failing closed if held by another process. Enforced 0o700 permissions on new parent directories.
review_remediation.defect_3_atomic_rollback_and_preflight: Implemented _preflight_storage_migration verifying absolute paths, symlinks, target collisions, and same-filesystem (st_dev) constraints. Added _fsync_dir for durable directory publication. Implemented reverse-order file rollback with directory fsync on partial rename or launch failure, preserving single recoverable authority.
review_remediation.defect_4_unit_tests_and_doc_correction: Replaced dummy string appends in test_worker_runner_heartbeat.py with real TaskStore CAS (append_state_commit) and real runtime_state APIs inside bwrap. Added unit tests for layout qualification, extraneous file rejection, and overlapping worktrees. Added unit tests in test_promote_supervisor_runtime.py for lock contention failure, preflight collision/symlink checks, 0700 permissions, and partial rename rollback. Corrected worker-atomic-state-mounts.md runbook claims and pytest verification command selectors.
review_remediation.cycle_2_defect_1_nested_workspace_readon: worker_runner._append_task_store_mounts now accepts read_only_worktree: bool and mounts nested workspace_path under outer_runtime as --ro-bind instead of writable --bind when read_only_worktree=True. Regression tests verify reviewer and finalize steps are strictly denied writes in nested worktrees under outer_runtime.
review_remediation.cycle_2_defect_2_preflight_destination_l: promote_supervisor_runtime._preflight_storage_migration now validates all target sidecars (.lock, .head.json, .legacy-anchor.json) across destination parent hierarchies, failing closed with target task-state collision error if any target lock or sidecar file exists or is a symlink before any moves occur.
review_remediation.cycle_2_defect_3_transient_publication_s: worker_runner._append_task_store_mounts catches FileNotFoundError when checking legitimate transient .tmp publication files that disappear mid-scan due to atomic os.replace, avoiding unqualified layout failures while preserving strict rejection for unrelated sibling files and symlinks.
review_remediation.cycle_2_defect_4_fixture_seeding_preserv: test_supervisor.ExecutionAuthorizationProcessTests seeds tasks.jsonl explicitly via canonical TaskStore API append_state_commit, preserving the strict production guard snapshot['event_count'] > 0 in common.py:4642.
review_remediation.cycle_2_defect_5_durable_rollback_retent: promote_supervisor_runtime._replace_supervisor_locked keeps single-writer flock exclusion across rollback and restart via keep_lock=True, durably fsyncs rollback directories, qualifies incumbent identity from incumbent config or command arguments, restarts incumbent supervisor with incumbent identity on candidate launch failure, and aggregates and raises rollback errors.
review_remediation.cycle_3_defect_1_partial_migration_rollb: scripts/promote_supervisor_runtime.py now raises StorageMigrationError carrying forward_error, migration_record, rollback_errors, restoration_verified, and lock_fd. In _replace_supervisor_locked, recovery diagnostics are extracted, single-writer lock exclusion is retained across rollback when restoration is not verified, and incumbent restart is refused against incomplete restoration / split storage.
review_remediation.cycle_3_defect_2_retained_old_path_write: .orchestrator/runtime_state.py resolves legacy .orchestrator paths to .orchestrator/worker-runtime/ via _canonical_runtime_source_path when worker-runtime authority exists. Direct write attempts to retired .orchestrator state/queue paths are hard-fenced in _write_runtime_bytes_unlocked, preventing split authority or divergent tokens without compatibility copies.
review_remediation.cycle_3_defect_3_incumbent_source_qualif: promote_supervisor_runtime.qualify_incumbent_identity validates exact immutable command root via validated_immutable_command_root before supervisor shutdown, verifies expected git head against incumbent identity when specified, removes arbitrary unvalidated mappings and directory basename head fabrication, and does not substitute candidate identity when absent. _replace_supervisor_locked validates incumbent identity prior to calling stop_existing_supervisor, failing closed before shutdown.
review_remediation.cycle_3_defect_4_durability_error_propag: promote_supervisor_runtime._fsync_dir removes OSError suppression so directory durability errors propagate directly into rollback and caller evidence. Destination directory hierarchy publication fsyncs new_event_log.parent.parent and new_p.parent.parent, and all fsynced directories are tracked and reported in migration evidence.
review_remediation.cycle_4_defect_1_retained_immutable_writ: qualify_and_drain_incumbent_writers drains running worker processes with timeout and fails closed if active supervisor phase reservations or in-flight queue events exist before cutover. _migrate_storage_paths establishes non-regular FIFO fences at retired state and approval queue paths, ensuring retained immutable writers fail closed on regular-file leaf assertions without recreating state files.
review_remediation.cycle_4_defect_2_configured_authority_pr: Removed _canonical_runtime_source_path and implicit existence-based compatibility redirection. runtime_state strictly uses config_path(config, key), preserving direct validation of configured paths and rejecting symlinks, split-roots, or outside-roots fail-closed even if worker-runtime/state.json exists.
review_remediation.cycle_4_defect_3_post_rename_config_dura: In _replace_supervisor_locked, if write_json_atomic encounters a directory fsync error (EIO) after rename, the rollback handler restores and verifies incumbent config on disk, rolls back migrated storage files, and only restarts the incumbent supervisor once on-disk verification succeeds. If restoration or verification fails, restart is refused and single-writer exclusion is retained.
review_remediation.cycle_4_defect_4_absent_incumbent_identi: In _replace_supervisor_locked, if qualify_incumbent_identity returns None (e.g. incumbent config lacks identity and watchdog commands), promotion fails closed immediately with RuntimeError before calling stop_existing_supervisor, preventing shutdown of incumbents without a qualified rollback target.
review_remediation.cycle_5_defect_1_fence_cleanup_restricti: _remove_retired_path_fence uses lstat mode checking and restricts cleanup strictly to verified fence objects (FIFOs or directories), leaving regular files and symlinks untouched. _rollback_storage_files implements idempotent reverse rollback, preserving already-restored files (where the original exists and destination is absent) and preventing outer rollback from unlinking restored state or head files on repeated rollback cycles. Comprehensive regression covers replace_supervisor with mixed restored/unrestored files and directory fsync durability errors.
review_remediation.cycle_5_defect_2_retired_fence_creation_: _create_retired_path_fence raises RuntimeError when FIFO and fallback directory creation fail (e.g. ENOSPC) or when verification fails, preventing migration from reporting false success with missing paths. Migration triggers transactional rollback, restoring original files and failing closed. Retained immutable writers continue operating safely against restored incumbent state without recreating empty state files.
